verification: Each scientific loop has separately implemented forward and backward calculations, focused producer comparisons and a complete source inventory. Normal and optimized Python repeat the same checks and are counted once. The new proof adapter additionally reruns independent arithmetic before admitting any evidence gate. Scientific file and domain review is separate from actual branch coverage; this release does not claim a fresh line-by-line audit of every historical file. Exact interval certificates establish their specified finite integral, not a full gauge-field continuum construction. The separate integration review passes62 named checks over18 routes: six accepted, nine missing-premise controls and three open targets. The independent reviewer also executed the optimized portable arithmetic replay.
